column1: # Curated pattern / culture bonuses for the rarity score (score model 2).
#   regex   matched with re.fullmatch() against the lower-cased username
#   class   a class key from src/rarity.py, or * for any class
#   offset  fraction of the class band, -1.0 .. 1.0
#           (a match uses the offset with the largest magnitude)
# These only move a name inside its band; they can never cross a class
# boundary.  The file is intentionally small and hand-curated: it is not a
# completeness claim, only a way to express the repeaters and culture strings
# Three-digit repeaters and culture strings sit near the top of their band.
# Repeaters in the short shape classes (aaa, zzz, abab, ..).
# Mixed short shapes: a digit at the edge reads better than one in the middle
# only marginally; keep the effect small.
